samples.reconstruction: Append the negative half-cycle, exactly as the tutorial's temporal anti-periodicity; no phase or magnitude fitting.

machine.name: Toyota_Prius
machine.desc: TOYOTA Prius 2004 interior magnet (V shape) with distributed winding

deviations: Skip the unrelated loaded branch and plot cells; change run name and output path only.

source.portable_registration_note: Local output directory and nonfunctional source material paths are replaced; embedded numerical curves and original registration hash are retained.

full_FEMM_registration.depth_policy: Use physical 0.08382 m FEMM depth directly; no subsequent stack multiplier.

native_registration.coordinate_policy: Rigidly rotate the complete Pyleecan mesh and magnetization vectors to align its half-slot-shifted origin with native slot centers; no physical change.
native_registration.physics: Exact FEMM nodes/triangles/material labels/magnet directions/zero sources/outer Dirichlet boundary; inner boundary natural.

limits_of_interpretation: Reproduction of a published tutorial workflow, not a published numerical BEMF acceptance target.
Common-mesh solver parity plus a separate sliding-band/symmetry comparison; no spatial convergence claim.
The 20 C no-load tutorial is a separate condition from the 60 C loaded-torque UI fixture.
No independent OEM hardware accuracy is inferred.
